title: RRB Group D 27 Nov 2025 Shift 1 - General Intelligence and Reasoning - Ranking
subject: General Intelligence and Reasoning

questions.q: Madhur ranked $58^{th}$ from the top and $6^{th}$ from the bottom in his class. How many students are there in his class?
questions.explain:
Total number of students = (Rank from top) + (Rank from bottom) - 1. 
Total = 58 + 6 - 1 = 64 - 1 = 63.
questions.subject: General Intelligence and Reasoning

questions.q: Radhika ranked $21^{st}$ from the top and $7^{th}$ from the bottom in her class. How many students are there in the class?
questions.explain: Total number of students = Rank from top + Rank from bottom - 1 = $21 + 7 - 1 = 28 - 1 = 27$.
